examples: The cup is full.
My bag is full of books.
The bus is full.

more.def: Holding as much as it can, with no room left.
examples: The stadium was full of cheering fans.
She poured juice until the glass was full.
The bus was so full that some people had to stand.
I am full after lunch.
He ate until he was full.
The cat is full.

more.def: Having eaten so much that you cannot eat any more.
examples: I'm too full to eat any more spaghetti.
The baby was full and pushed the spoon away.
After the big meal, everyone felt full and sleepy.
We had fun.
Swimming is fun.
It was a lot of fun.

more.def: Enjoyment, or something that makes you happy and gives you a good time.
examples: We had so much fun at the water park.
The class played games just for fun.
Building a snowman is fun on a cold day.
It was a fun game.
What a fun day!
That is a fun toy.
The party was fun, with games and music.
She is a fun friend who always makes me laugh.
We had a fun day at the fair.
The joke is funny.
A funny clown.
That was so funny!
The clown's funny hat made the whole crowd laugh.
My uncle tells funny stories about his dog.
It was funny when the puppy chased its own tail.
That is a funny noise.
The milk tastes funny.
He has a funny look.

more.def: Strange or unusual in a way that is hard to explain.
examples: The soup has a funny taste.
I heard a funny noise coming from the engine.
It is funny how quiet the house is when everyone is gone.
Dad was furious when the dog ate the cake.
The furious bee buzzed at us.
Mom was furious about the mud on the rug.
She was furious when she found out someone had broken her model.
The coach was furious when the team skipped practice.
He was furious with himself for losing his new jacket.

easy.def: The time that has not come yet.
examples: In the future, I want to be a vet.
We will have a new school in the future.
No one can see the future.

more.def: The time that is still to come, after now.
examples: No one knows exactly what will happen in the future.
In the future, cars may drive themselves.
She is saving her money for the future.
